questions.q: Why does Tom ask Mia for help instead of buying the gift himself?
choices: The birthday party has already ended.
He is not allowed to visit the city.
His work finishes too late for him to shop.
Eva has asked him to stay at home.
questions.explanation: Tom works at the bicycle shop until seven in the evening.

questions.q: Why does Mia immediately reject the idea of another book?
choices: Eva did not use the book Tom gave her last year.
All bookshops in town are closed.
Eva has already bought every new book.
Tom does not know how to read.
questions.explanation: Mia recalls that the previous book remained unopened.

questions.q: Why are concert tickets not a good choice this time?
choices: Eva no longer likes music.
There are no tickets left for Eva's favourite band's concert.
The concert is tonight in another town.
The tickets are cheaper than the budget.
questions.explanation: Tom says the tickets for the next month's performance are sold out.

questions.q: Why does Mia think the climbing gift card is better than headphones?
choices: It can only be used by professional climbers.
It costs more than all the headphones.
It requires Eva to travel abroad.
It suits Eva's interests and fits Tom's budget.
questions.explanation: The centre offers two visits for twenty-eight euros, within Tom's limit.

questions.q: What makes the gift card especially suitable for Eva?
choices: She dislikes all outdoor and indoor sports.
She already has very expensive headphones.
She finds her school climbing wall too easy.
She can only use the card at school.
questions.explanation: Tom says Eva wants a greater climbing challenge.

questions.q: What is one advantage of the gift card offering two visits?
choices: Eva can go climbing with someone else.
It pays for a whole year of sports.
It can be exchanged for a concert.
It guarantees a personal instructor.
questions.explanation: Mia suggests that the two-visit card lets Eva take a friend.

questions.q: Why can Mia buy the gift despite her time at the library?
choices: The library sells climbing equipment.
She does not need to leave the library.
Tom will buy the card during work.
The climbing centre stays open until late evening.
questions.explanation: The centre's late opening leaves Mia time after the library closes.

questions.q: What does Tom plan to contribute after Mia buys the present?
choices: A new concert ticket.
A birthday card that they can both write in.
An expensive set of headphones.
A second climbing centre membership.
questions.explanation: Tom offers to get a birthday card and write it together.

questions.q: Why does Mia suggest putting Eva's birthday in a phone calendar?
choices: It may help Tom remember the date next year.
It will reduce the price of gifts.
It tells Eva about the surprise early.
It makes the shops stay open later.
questions.explanation: Mia jokes that Tom should use a reminder next year.

questions.q: Which response from Tom best confirms the plan?
choices: Buy the concert tickets even if they are sold out.
I'll leave work now and go shopping with you.
Please get the climbing card; I'll bring a birthday card and meet you at the bus stop.
Give Eva the book I bought last year again.
questions.explanation: A clear reply confirms the gift and the friends' agreed contributions.
